items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: You played with him a long time, Nero?

ctx.x: You played with him a long time, Nero? Yeah, I played Maurice Durand down there a long time. Maurice and all that? And he was the bass player and I was playing with the Olympia Suriners and all the pass. I remember he did that, and it all, but he didn't. Cam Wright started playing bass again. But he's dead now. Oh yeah. He's got a son just like him. What did Maurice Durand do on Carnival? Now you tell me about that. On Carnival we used to play the Arabian Packing Company parade. From the Seminart, right down there.
From the Seminart, right down there.
